descricao:
Game inspired by Michael Evan's short film (2AM: The Smiling Man)

A game where a completely mad man, who watches you and stalks you during a temporarily peaceful night, is ready to flee this terrifying danger?

The masked killer in the camp is killing everyone. Who does he want to avenge?

A vengeful and angry killer is killing everyone in the camp, are you ready to escape? or are you ready to die?

Texas killer wants to kill and record everything!

A masked killer from Texas is on the loose killing and recording everything, the killer plans to attack yet another victim in a Texas apartment, will you survive this attack!?

A new sequence is being made, this time... I am working with the script of the sequence, something I didn't do before. What I can say about the sequence is that the game will be much bigger, with 1 hour or more of gameplay, and I will try my best to make it not as repetitive as the previous one was.

Short horror game with VHS and PS1 style graphics

The protagonist takes on the role of an Urban Explorer, where this time, he decides to explore a forest called 'Raven Wood', where there is a legend that says there is a creature that is not human, but has a similar form, that kills anyone who dares to enter it. According to reports, these creatures emerged through a ritual, and according to rumors, all those who dared to enter the forest never came out, except for one person who managed to survive after entering this place, and mysteriously was killed 2 weeks after visiting the place.

Game based on the creepypasta The Smiling Man, created by Blue Tidal, and recreation of the first game.

It's back! In this remake you can play through the real story told by Blue Tidal, as well as the alternative story, which is a recreation of the first game. In this remake too, the music and sounds have been recreated, with each ending having its own music.

The suspense part of the game was inspired by some famous horror movies from the 80s/90s.

As the main story is based on the real story of Blue Tidal, it ends up being very short, unlike the alternative story which is a recreation and reimagining of the first game.

The "Baby Face" killer is wanted! Mason seeks fame by breaking into "Baby Face's" home.

In "The Wanted Man's House," plunge into the shadows of a slasher suspense, inspired by iconic horror films from the '80s and '90s. Take on the role of Mason, a daring adventurer in pursuit of fame, determined to break into the infamous residence of the sought-after killer known as "Baby Face."

The story unfolds as Mason, armed with courage and a camera, discovers that the location of the house has been inadvertently revealed by his own friends. His goal? Record every chilling moment to expose the terror in the city's newspaper. However, things take an unexpected turn when Baby Face returns home. Are you ready to face the nightmare?

PS1-style slasher horror game inspired by Resident Evil and some horror films from the 80s and 90s.

Explore the hidden terror in the depths of Whispering Woods forest in this slasher game inspired by PS1 classics and horror films from the '80s and '90s. Jackson Foster and Noah Carter's tranquil journey turns into a nightmare as night falls, revealing sinister secrets and a masked killer. Feel the adrenaline as you navigate the dark scenery, immerse yourself in the suspense of a gripping plot, and get ready for moments of pure terror, where the line between legend and reality blurs. Survive the silent trail and unravel the mysteries hidden in the darkness.

The creature from MountWood is real! and it has claimed yet another victim. Who and how will they solve the case?

In "The MountWood Creature," you take on the role of Joseph, an unemployed man desperate for a job. Accepting a position at a remote watchtower in the MountWood forest, he soon discovers that his new job is more terrifying than he could have ever imagined.

Night Maniac is a horror game that puts you in the role of Jonathan, a young man who finds himself caught up in a series of terrifying events after a shocking escape. The story takes place in the town of Red Valley. The game also tells the story of John, a local employee at Red Valley Butcher.

Hank, a determined police officer, comes on the scene to investigate and locate a dangerous fugitive, fearing that he may be closer than anyone imagines. As the tension rises, Jonathan and Hank are forced to confront a true nightmare as they try to survive a growing threat, the night maniac.

The Unlit Sun is a psychological horror game played from a first-person perspective, delving into the boundaries between consciousness and the unknown. Trapped in a distorted world shaped by a mysterious entity named Nyctarion, Ethan struggles to escape a dark reality forged by buried secrets and enigmatic symbolism. In an atmosphere filled with tension and looming danger, every decision draws the protagonist closer to—or further from—his fate. Uncover a deep and unsettling story where light and darkness are two sides of the same power.

titulo: Night Maniac 2: The Legacy Of Blood
descricao:
The Red Valley Killer returned! and is now in GreenFord!

Terror returns in Night Maniac 2: The Legacy of Blood, diving even deeper into the darkness that haunts Red Valley. Years have passed, but the scars of the past never truly fade. Now, a new wave of blood threatens the town, echoing a horror many believed was long buried.

Obsession and fear walk hand in hand as mysteries unravel, revealing that some shadows never disappear—they only wait for the right moment to resurface. Face the terror head-on, uncover dark secrets, and fight to survive, because the blood legacy is far from over.

Reclaim the PS1-style terror of The Smiling Man with new scenes, lore, upgraded AI chase, and a new ending.

The Smiling Man: Legacy Edition, a relaunch designed to faithfully echo the spirit and simplicity of the original game while adding fresh content for longtime fans.

In this Legacy Edition, you’ll find brand-new scenes and environments, a fifth ending, and an expanded origin story for the Smiling Man. We’ve sharpened his pursuit AI, squashed long-standing bugs, and restored cut content—all to recreate the tense, low-poly atmosphere you loved in the first title, with modern polish and surprising new twists.

Welcome to the final version of The Smiling Man! I hope you enjoy it!

PS1 Style Horror game. Two friends stranded at a farmhouse, silence becomes threat.

The Soul is a suspenseful slasher with a PS1-era aesthetic, set in a remote rural landscape. Two friends, a house in the middle of nowhere, and a presence that turns silence into a threat. Restrained imagery, shadows that reveal less than they suggest, and a steadily growing tension conveyed through the stillness of the fields.

The Soul began development around November or December of 2022, but was eventually canceled. In 2025, I decided not only to return to its development but to completely recreate it.

A legend returns. The cold Red Wood stand unnervingly silent… yet something stirs beneath the stillness. Has he come back to life? Is the hunter once thought lost now stalking these woods again? Brace yourself: the forest remembers every secret, and this time, nothing will stay buried.

Don't Stop in Red Wood: Chapter 1 and 2 recreates the feeling of survival horror with graphics inspired by the PS1 era, with the possibility of playing in fixed tank-style cameras and first-person camera. The game tries to follow an older graphic style with a mix of modern gameplay. The game contains hand-crafted cutscenes to give the story a more cinematic feel.

She Wears My Face is a short narrative horror game set in Fort Worth, Texas.

Jennie Jones hasn’t slept well in a long time. Every week she sits in a therapist’s office and answers the same question: does she still appear? And every week the answer is yes. Same face. Same stare. Always far away.

Until today.

You walk Jennie home after her session, get the house ready for the night, and try to rest. It sounds simple. It isn’t. The street feels wrong, the house feels quieter than it should, and the thing that has been watching from a distance has stopped keeping its distance.
